Description

The larger version of a bulette with extra armor-plating and larger spines.

Defense

AC 26, touch 11; flat-footed 23 (+2 dex, +1 dodge, +15 natural, -2 size)

hp 184 [240] (16d8+112)

Fort +16, Ref +12, Will +9

Defensive Abilities Spines; DR 5/cold-iron; Resist Earth 20, Fire 10

Offense

Speed 40 ft.

Melee 2 Claws +18 (2d6+8), Bite +19 (2d8+12/19-20)

Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.

Special Attacks Leap, Savage Bite

Statistics

Str 26, Dex 15, Con 22, Int 2, Wis 14, Cha 6

Base Atk +12; CMB +22; CMD 35 (39 vs. trip)

Feats Cleave, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Perception), Toughness, Weapon Focus (Bite)

Skills Acrobatics +14 (+22 jumping), Perception +16, Racial Modifiers +8 on Acrobatics checks made to jump

description.value: A sharnbulette can perform a special kind of pounce attack by jumping into combat. When a sharnbulette charges, it can make a DC 20 Acrobatics check to jump into the air and land next to its enemies. If it makes the Acrobatics check, it can follow up with four claw attacks against foes in reach, but cannot make a bite attack.

effect: Charge and pass DC 20 Acrobatics; four claws, no bite.

description.value: A sharnbulette's bite is particularly dangerous. It applies 1-1/2 times its Strength modifier to damage inflicted with its bite attack, and threatens a critical hit on a 19-20.

effect: A sharnbulette's bite is particularly dangerous. It applies 1-1/2 times its Strength modifier to damage inflicted with its bite attack, and threatens a critical hit on a 19-20.

damages.raw: 2 times its Strength modifier to damage

description.value: A sharnbulette has large spines that jut from between its armor plates; any creature attacking it with natural attacks or unarmed strikes take 1d6 damage and must make a DC 16 Reflex save or have the quill break off and embed in its flesh. Lodged quills impose a -1 penalty on attacks, saves, and skill checks per quill. The save DC is Dexterity-based.
